validatorSnapshot.notes: Initial Interchain validators are selected from config/validators/initial.json. Their public BLS possession proofs must bind origin 1643 and destination 56 and be verified against the deployed BSC verifier. No PoS snapshot or private key enters the admin.

reserve.notes: BNB-denominated validator reserve and executor reimbursement are intentionally unapproved. Set positive reviewed wei values in a later main commit before ValidatorRegistry deployment; do not inherit ETH-spoke economic values without review.

sourceFee.notes: Initial native BNB-denominated source validator fee requires explicit operator approval. Factory deployment remains blocked until the fee is committed and shown in the wallet preview.

notes: Preparation only: BSC EIP-2537 precompiles (BEP-439) and finalized RPC must pass live read-only checks. Wallet deployment starts at the verifier. ValidatorRegistry additionally needs verified public destination-domain BLS proofs and reviewed initial BNB parameters. No contract addresses are inferred or pre-populated.
